attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-node RabbitMQ cluster (node1/node2/node3, AlmaLinux 9.6) serving AMQP over TLS backed by a cluster-dedicated self-signed CA. Clients must present a certificate issued by that CA to connect on 5671 (mutual TLS, fail_if_no_peer_cert=true); plaintext AMQP (5672) is disabled entirely. The management UI (15672) and inter-node ports (25672, epmd 4369) are firewalled via firewalld rich rules to the cluster's own subnet (10.100.40.0/24) only; 5671 is the only port opened beyond the cluster. Verified cluster formation, TLS enforcement, management reachability from within the cluster, and quorum-queue replication across all three nodes. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol for all three nodes with boot-id proof and full post-restart health/quorum verification.
